timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1500–1510 KRW/USD (expected level); currently higher before decline

WHY: The news shows conflicting signals—one source predicts the won will *strengthen* (rates falling to 1500s, making dollars cheaper), while another warns rates recently hit 17-year highs (won weakening, making dollars expensive). Financial authorities have verbally intervened to calm volatility, suggesting current levels may be temporarily elevated but unstable.

TIP: Given the volatility and conflicting outlook, consider splitting your $2,000 monthly purchase into 2–3 smaller transactions to average out timing risk rather than converting the full amount when rates are uncertain.

articles.title: 고삐 풀린 환율 17년래 최고…실물경제 ‘휘청’
articles.summary: 원·달러 환율이 금융위기 수준까지 치솟으며 실물경제에 부담을 줄 수 있다는 우려가 커지고 있다. 금융당국의 구두 개입에 상승세는 일단 진정됐지.
